firm_data.firm_description: Siegel & Coonerty, LLP is a New York personal injury law firm with decades of experience. They are dedicated to representing individuals who sustained serious bodily injury as a result of accidents and errors in medical care.
notable_facts: They have recovered millions for personal injury survivors.

email.subject: AI for Siegel & Coonerty, LLP: built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Nancy,

Siegel & Coonerty has built something impressive since 2011: a 9-attorney practice handling complex medical malpractice and construction accident cases across New York. That's exactly the profile we're seeing succeed with Lucio.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
